comparison.objective: PR-771 closes an edge joint between two boards by pumping a one-hand bar clamp and leaves sustained clamping force; the candidate adjusts and locks a robot-gripper opening stop and verifies its motion.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-771 tests placing a clamp around boards, repeated trigger strokes, board alignment, and force buildup; the candidate tests precision screw adjustment, thin-nut wrenching, bimanual counterholding, tool withdrawal, and lever-driven cycling.
comparison.success_condition: PR-771 grades jaw and joint gaps, at least 20 N clamping force, board alignment, release, stillness, and loss from the table; the candidate grades a 90° setting, lock retention, three repeatable cycles, drift, retained nuts, and clearance.
comparison.reason: The tasks share only generic force application and hands-off verification, not the same mechanism, manipulation, or outcome; no material rubric detail is missing.
